name: characters
title_zh: 按剧本连续性圣经，给每个角色写一张出图提示卡
tagline_zh: 剧本里角色换了三套衣服、伤疤时有时无，出图就崩。它读连续性圣经，把每个角色的外貌、服装、状态拆成一张独立提示卡。
tagline_en: Your screenplay bible says the scar is on the left cheek. It turns each character into a standalone prompt sheet.
desc_en: Write one sheet per character, in the words an image model needs, from the screenplay's continuity bible.
why_zh: 它不写小说式外貌描写，而是按出图模型的语法拆成可复用的字段，让同一角色在不同镜头里长得像同一个人。
why_en: It skips literary description and outputs model-parseable fields, so the same character looks like the same person across shots.
limit_zh: 必须先有一份写好的连续性圣经，没有它这件直接空转；只产出文字提示卡，不生成任何图片。
limit_en: Requires an existing continuity bible, or it does nothing. Outputs text prompt sheets only, no images. Undescribed traits are left blank, not.
title_en: One image-model prompt sheet per character, from the.
